meta.name: review-batch
meta.description: Batch-review the diffs from several agents in one sitting with per-change re-entry cards, instead of cold-reloading one agent at a time. Triggers "review batch", "review all the agents", "what's pending review", "batch review", "catch up on agent work", or after fanning out several agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量审查多个智能体提交的代码变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一次性审查多个开发者或智能体提交的代码差异
copy.tagline_en: Batch review code diffs from multiple agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to review diffs from several agents in one go

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能一次审查多个 agent 的更改，为每个更改生成“重新进入卡片”，让您在一个对话中完成所有审查，而不是逐个加载 agent。
howto.when: 当您说出“review batch”、“review all the agents”、“what's pending review”等关键词，或者同时派出多个 agent 后触发。

say.text: 审查所有 agent 的待办更改
say.note: Claude 会收集更改并展示卡片。

say.text: 批量审查最近的 agent 工作
say.note: Claude 会列出队列深度和更改摘要。

say.text: 看看有哪些 agent 的变更未审查
say.note: Claude 会生成每项变更的审查卡片。

howto.what_en: Claude batches the diffs from multiple agents into one review session, creating re-entry cards per change, so you review all at once instead of cold-loading each agent separately.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "review batch", "review all the agents", "what's pending review", or after fanning out several agents.

say_en.note: Claude gathers the changes and shows cards.
Claude lists queue depth and change summary.
Claude generates review cards for each change.
